specification.input_notes: Raw sequencing reads from SRA under BioProject PRJNA522349. The four runs (SRR8575422-SRR8575425) correspond to PM and TM samples for 16S and ITS amplicon sequencing. No version or additional identifiers provided.
specification.comparison_metric: Exact match of reported OTU counts.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Counts must match exactly as printed.
specification.specification_gaps: The paper does not specify the exact bioinformatics pipeline, clustering algorithm, or reference database used for OTU picking; it refers to 'described elsewhere [13]'. The assignment of runs to PM/TM and 16S/ITS is not explicitly stated in the paper.
